svg.title: Mouse model
svg.desc: Laboratory mouse in side profile with detailed ear, eye, whiskers, paws, tail, and body contour. Biological basis: The laboratory mouse has a compact rodent body plan with prominent pinnae, vibrissae, digit-bearing paws, and a long tapering tail.
